notes.title: Lorne Demo Live Stream
notes.content: In a wartorn world you are key to restore peace and order to the lands of Lorne. Equip Evelyn with the right tools you can find, craft or upgrade in this ARPG featuring interactive combat, open world exploration and intimidating temples filled with puzzles. End the corruption and keep Lorne safe.

notes.title: Monthly Update: September
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/d0bef99840ff614cef33f498242b0070061f78a3.png[/img]

Hello!

Great news! 

It looks like the demo is ready next month!!!! There will be a playtesting round before that just in order to make some improvements, but after that I think we are actually good to go.


[b]Swimming- [/b]
I finally added swimming to the game. Now you will be able to explore Lorne both above and below the water surface!

[previewyoutube=EKctKAqrnt4;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]New Enemy-[/b]
A new enemy supporting the heavy zombie infantry, here are some characteristics of our new enemy serving the undead side, The Imp:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/0d53df86e619a22a9a4b38a432fcb0e0d98193fc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Low health
[*] Low experience yield
[*] Low damage
[*] High rate of fire
[*] Spawns in large numbers
[/list]
[previewyoutube=2mugzCJkyqg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Ambient NPC-[/b]
I spent some time after last month to add some life to the village of Nortshire. Some of the things I have added since last time:
[list]
[*] Carpenter working on different parts of the village
[*] Low density pedestrians
[*] Woodchopper
[*] Man tending fire
[*] Fisherman
[/list] 
[previewyoutube=R0yjeww-5C8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Corruption Barriers- [/b]
Corruption barriers can be found across Lorne. Be careful! These are conjured by the powerful Lich Yk'Voz in an effort to drain the life from the land. They regularly spawn unholy creatures, take these down before they get out of hand, or soon an entire army wont be enough to stop them.
[list]
[*] Imps will spawn in groups around the player when you come close to a corruption barrier
[*] Waves will spawn repeatedly untill you have destroyed all the power cores for the barrier
[*] One last guardian will spawn once you destroy the barrier
[/list] 
[previewyoutube=jmkXHBOE9Tc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Signposts and Healthbars- [/b]
Other additions to Lorne:
[list]
[*] Cleaned up healthbars
[*] Added signposts that gives you directions
[*] Added rules that show up when you're next to a time challenge
[/list]

Healthbar before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/b030fe9184180a0f9d16270970610cf8bea7a9a5.png[/img]

Healthbar after:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/fa95a05ebe0b45a9ca8c7357a2ebcfcd5c55a8dd.png[/img]

Signposts:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/960a3bba6356f1436ddebfc03479e3ece905ace4.png[/img]

Rules for Timechallenge:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/a94f511123dc6f81657a2b550932ddfccf56459d.png[/img]



Thank you for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/9e7f160e310547d13a30a8399f7585735d269cea.png[/img]

notes.title: Monthly Update: August
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/d0bef99840ff614cef33f498242b0070061f78a3.png[/img]

Hello!

In August one of the biggest leaps so far were made. The demo is closer than ever and I can't wait to publish it here within a few months!

Here is a short video of gameplay from the starting zone: 
[previewyoutube=8sw8CFq8uOs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Voice Acting- [/b]
The whole demo questchain is now fully voice acted and implemented. The idea is to have the entirety of the mainstory voiced, while the sidequests and npcs will be non verbal with emotion expressed through sound/non verbal instead.

[b]Weather-[/b]
There is now active weather in Lorne. The idea long term is that they all can affect the player in different ways. Here are some weather types implemented:
[list]
[*] Thunderstorms
[*] Rain
[*] Snow
[*] Sunny
[*] Overcast
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/7a65f52866e92405ac3e0cbbff540895864d40d7.png[/img]

[b]Polishing the Demo-[/b]
A lot of effort this past month has been to make the demo feel smoother and get rid of any obvious bugs I have encountered when playtesting. Here is a list of general polish:
[list]
[*] Added background music to starting zone
[*] Created a smooth camera transition for title reveal cinematic
[*] Lysander is now a single entity, following you through the tutorial cave
[*] Made the level up vfx more performant
[*] Created a new explosive vfx for explosive items
[*] Harmonized all interactive vfx to a single vfx type
[*] Added soul dust drop ranges instead of fixed amount
[*] Increased crafting costs for all items
[*] Created artificial rimlight for the character and brightened textures to make Evelyn "pop" a bit more
[*] Changed some animations for spear attacks
[/list] 
New explosive VFX
[previewyoutube=Kjqkqk4NOnE;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Shopkeepers- [/b]
Implementing a basic shopkeeper for the game turned out to be way more troublesome than I first thought. The hardest part was probably allowing for questgivers to carry dialogue and act as questgivers if needed. 
[list]
[*] Added item descriptions and lore texts to 112 items, trinkets and potions
[*] Goldchecks, do the player have enough gold?
[*] Transfer items
[*] Possibility to run out of stock
[*] Greeting/Dismiss voicelines
[*] Integrate them with quest and dialogue systems
[*] Making them possible to edit in the world, allowing endless amount of deviations from the 3 vendor presets I made.
[/list] 
Example of item description:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/2e7164b7609bd05edf0b7a75cf9f5c0f753abc40.png[/img]

[b]Questgivers- [/b]
Most attention were probably put into making and implementing the questgivers. In order to make them feel alive a lot of tiny details were added to their behavior. Here are the most obvious ones:
[list]
[*] Added a blacksmith Questgiver
[*] Headtracking - questgivers now track you with their heads when you get close
[*] Created different animations that are played when you are getting closer(such as sitting down or standing up when you are nearby)
[*] Added events for the questgiver such as follow player or run to position.
[*] Questgivers can now jump over obstacles
[*] Added an automatic unstuck feature as a fallback
[/list]
Nortshire blacksmith
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/f69a0ca538377c55df4c291e7d6623d696a4f6a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/261b309cd86af010b21cb215fdbd5450c0a22167.png[/img]

Headtracking
[previewyoutube=Fc1IsBU4tbw;full][/previewyoutube]

Questgiver events
[previewyoutube=ngTMV230W8w;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/9e7f160e310547d13a30a8399f7585735d269cea.png[/img]

notes.title: Monthly Update: July
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/d0bef99840ff614cef33f498242b0070061f78a3.png[/img]

Hello!

Here is the second monthly update of Lorne.

July was a busy month.. Below is a list of the biggest achievements that I am the most hyped to share:

[b]Tutorial update- [/b]
After a little over a month of work on the first playable minutes of Lorne, most things are in place. Some of the things that is added to the tutorial are:
[list]
[*] Lighting
[*] Quests
[*] Dialogue
[*] Voicelines
[*] Introduction to puzzle mechanics
[/list]

[previewyoutube=MC0CNA52VdY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Game Title Reveal- [/b]
I have been working on learning how to make shorter cinematics. Though I am still learning how to do these things, I was pretty happy how the title reveal came out. Have a watch!

[previewyoutube=shMXNUcYzh0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Combat Introduction-[/b]
A lot of effort this past month has been to make the quest system and the dialogue system work together in a way that is efficient to build content once it is done. A few of the features of the integrated systems can be seen in the combat introduction: 
[list]
[*] Run code at any specific point while in dialogue
[*] Spawn objects and assign them as current quest obejctive
[*] Condition checks preventing you from progressing untill you completed an objective
[/list] 

[previewyoutube=Y_6QzH40-fY;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Voice Actors- [/b]
I am extremely glad to be able to work with such incredibly creative people. 

Though my ambition would be to have everything in the game voiced, it's simply not possibly for a self funded indie developer like me at this scale, however the main story will be voiced by the key characters. If the opportunity for funding comes up it will allow me to add additional voice acted characters!

But for now, let's meet the team!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/7fbbc7042d90acd9c18651bd626417f6b8b54fa2.png[/img]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/3c7208a71c356c0f22e3a5e3d9b38b41813616f7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/b342a82b591c7996698b847bc6dad45ec3768795.jpg[/img][/url] 
[b]- Katie Harvey(As Evelyn)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/727decabd90d9f3d6a76df100623b40d7f817f91.png[/img]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/00ec6e77341ac7b194e6292be83fd9a7429623a6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/0324aa8cae53a79331068718d34515ba70c3f8ba.jpg[/img][/url]
[b] - Chuck Brown (As Valyrion)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/f1bbeb50a2f9e74dce31c009b7b56a1d7f80bd6f.png[/img]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/94745dc532ad36ecc0c3633331ca02da888636a2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/979473578b4894710720a72a7c7acc76aebd6f08.jpg[/img][/url]
 [b]- Reeko Brooks(As Lysander) [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/153ca1f1b2270f03a9527fb9212ce82b2a047293.png[/img]


For the next months focus my efforts will largely be put into expanding the questchain for the upcoming demo, where you craft your ranger sword since you lost your equipment(Yikes) in that little exercise led by Valyrion.

[b]General Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Physics button no longer trigger unwanted voicelines.
[*] Explosive arrows no longer push back static opponents.
[*] Ragdoll effects no longer bugs out on death.
[*] Climbing was blocked in certain areas unintentionally.
[*] Despawn timer is now adjusted to duration of a death montage rather than a hard number.


[/list]

Thanks for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/9e7f160e310547d13a30a8399f7585735d269cea.png[/img]

notes.title: Monthly Update: June
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/d0bef99840ff614cef33f498242b0070061f78a3.png[/img]

Hello!

Starting from this month, the first or second week in I'll write a short recap of everything that was done the previous month.

June was a busy month on several fronts. Below is a list of the biggest achievements:

Steam store Overhaul- The steam store page has received some long overdue love. All the store art have been upgraded, and will published promptly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/1e4d6b95f4e03dcc7ff63aedf5625490c149fee7.png[/img]

Dialogue&Quests- Finally the quest system and the dialogue system integrated with each other. Right now all the expected functionality is there, but dialogue is not yet saved over to different sessions.

[previewyoutube=QI4uKtLAK1U;full][/previewyoutube]


Interactive Foliage- Foliage now reacts to the players position, and make sounds when you pass through it. See the video for a short showcase!

[previewyoutube=QxZ_9Sdnwb0;full][/previewyoutube]

Camps- I made a short recording of defeating a camp in the starting zone, just to make sure it works as expected. Defeat all guardians in order to unlock the chest for loot.

[previewyoutube=i0PupiXXikE;full][/previewyoutube]


Tutorial Cave- FINALLY! The tutorial cave, which is a large part of the demo is coming along nicely. There are some recording of voicelines to do, and some npcs to add.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/0586054c502c342bb2dadb49cbd62b454aca66d5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/dd8a25926ef2094ee2e062895bc6a6beacb882e3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/015f1e537f141395b29ba25139c446c1df1a482e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/aaf8f873da79385940f25ed56a87333826582a88.png[/img]



General Bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Angle that AI can detect you is reduced
[*] You can now do twice the damage with headshots
[*] Battlecamp reset bug is solved
[*] Interact button now disappears when you start a dialogue
[*] You will no longer interrupt dialogue by other inputs
[*] If there is no recent save the game now restarts instead of getting stuck
[*] YK'Voz Magic masks are no longer wandering around
[*] Dialogue sfx now only plays on successful dialogue progression
[*] Dialogue is no longer randomly interrupted due to standing on the border of the "talkable area" 
[*] Quest givers are no longer affected by explosive arrows
[*] NPC's can no longer trigger wander while dead
[/list]

Thanks for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479596/9e7f160e310547d13a30a8399f7585735d269cea.png[/img]
